# Atlas

## Goal

Atlas is the rollout of the new search stack: replace the old index, move every team to the new query service, and keep the quality numbers above the agreed floor during the whole migration. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
## Risks

The main risks are the data migration window, the capacity of the query service, and the training of the support team before the cut-over date. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
